preprocess_multi_choice_line: preprocess a multi-choice QA line by extracting options and formatting input output pairs
normalize_answer_text: normalize an answer string by lowercasing removing punctuation articles and extra whitespace
apply_prompt_to_example: apply a prompt template to a dataset example and return formatted input output and options
download_google_drive_file: download a file from Google Drive by ID and optionally unzip if it is a zip archive
get_majority_element: get the majority element from a list returning None if there is a tie
